atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.domain_name: A. Vertical Aerosol Structure & Aerosol Type
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.physical_quantity: Vertical aerosol extinction profile k_a(z), SSA, asymmetry parameter g, aerosol speciation
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.initial_rationale: Absorbing aerosol layers above cloud height attenuate direct and diffuse flux differently than boundary-layer aerosols
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.information_source: CALIPSO/CALIOP LiDAR, EarthCARE, CAMS 3D aerosol profiles
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.physical_materiality: IMMATERIAL (Background AOD550 ~0.03-0.08; layer height variation alters GHI <1.5 W/m²)
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.causal_availability: NON-CAUSAL (No 3D NRT aerosol LiDAR covers Nuolja with t_pub <= t0)
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.spatial_representativeness: Low (Coarse 0.4° CAMS grid smears local mountain aerosol structure)
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.novelty_relative_to_stage8_1: High theoretical novelty, but immaterial for pristine sub-Arctic air masses
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.exact_closure_reason: Background Arctic aerosol is too clean for 3D vertical structure to alter broadband surface GHI above noise (<1.5 W/m²), and no causal NRT 3D profile dataset exists
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.reopen_conditions: Severe episodic wildfire/volcanic plume (AOD550 > 0.5) with causally verified 3D LiDAR product

atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.physical_quantity: Vertical humidity q(p) profile distribution across pressure levels for fixed column TCWV
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.initial_rationale: Pressure broadening of near-IR H2O lines (gamma proportional to p) causes slight absorption variation for vertical profile shifts
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.information_source: MEPS 3D pressure-level fields, ERA5, radiosonde profiles
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.physical_materiality: IMMATERIAL (Profile shifts for fixed TCWV alter GHI <1.8 W/m²)
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.causal_availability: CAUSAL PASS (MEPS 3D fields available at t0 = 00:00 UTC)
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.novelty_relative_to_stage8_1: ZERO NOVELTY (Stage 8.1 already includes q(p) and RH(p) at 925, 850, 700, 500 hPa)
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.relationship_to_tested_routes: Extends Stage 8.6 (CAMS TCWV) and Stage 8.1 baseline features
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.exact_closure_reason: Physically immaterial broadband impact (<1.8 W/m²) and 100% informationally redundant with existing Stage 8.1 MEPS pressure-level humidity features
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.reopen_conditions: None (MEPS 3D humidity fields already fully present in operational champion)

atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.physical_quantity: Stratospheric and tropospheric ozone absorption in Hartley-Huggins and Chappuis bands
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.initial_rationale: High-latitude ozone exhibits strong seasonal and synoptic variability (280-420 DU) over Lapland
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.information_source: CAMS global TCO3 forecasts, OMI/TROPOMI satellite observations
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.physical_materiality: IMMATERIAL (100 DU variation alters broadband GHI <0.75 W/m²)
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.causal_availability: CAUSAL PASS (CAMS TCO3 forecasts available before t0)
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.novelty_relative_to_stage8_1: High physical novelty, but immaterial magnitude
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.exact_closure_reason: Broadband solar shortwave attenuation by ozone is quantitatively negligible (<0.75 W/m²) relative to 36.19 W/m² model MAE
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.reopen_conditions: Only relevant for narrow UV spectral band forecasting (UV-A/UV-B); zero relevance for broadband GHI

atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.physical_quantity: Elastic scattering of solar photons by N2, O2 molecules scaling as lambda^-4 and surface pressure Ps
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.initial_rationale: Major clear-sky shortwave attenuation mechanism at high solar zenith angles
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.information_source: Rayleigh scattering formulation (tau_R proportional to Ps * m(theta_z))
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.physical_materiality: MATERIAL BUT DERIVABLE (20-50 W/m² clear-sky attenuation, but deterministic function of Ps and zenith angle)
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.causal_availability: CAUSAL PASS (psfc and solar_elevation causally available)
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.novelty_relative_to_stage8_1: ZERO NOVELTY (100% deterministically inferable from Stage 8.1 features psfc, solar_elevation, zenith, DOY, clearsky_ghi)
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.exact_closure_reason: 100% mathematically and informationally redundant with existing Stage 8.1 features

atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.physical_quantity: Molecular absorption in near-IR solar windows (O2-A band 760nm, CO2 bands 1.6µm and 2.0µm)
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.initial_rationale: Complete audit of all atmospheric absorbers in the solar spectrum
atmospheric_radiative_physics_audits.physical_materiality: NEGLIGIBLE (Temporal fluctuations across 2024 alter broadband GHI <0.10 W/m²)

routes_with_qualified_provisional_closur.route: Stage 8.24 (Scandes Orographic Flow & Mountain Froude Number)
routes_with_qualified_provisional_closur.tested: Faithful discrete layer-integrated N_layer over P_sfc -> 700 hPa layer + U_perp representation (39 features)
routes_with_qualified_provisional_closur.demonstrated: Faithful discrete layer-integrated U_perp + Froude candidate degraded EVEN MAE (+0.2543 W/m2) and failed Gates G1-G4 (1/5 folds improving, worst fold = +0.7186 W/m2). 0/21,694 sublayer N2 floor activations.
routes_with_qualified_provisional_closur.not_demonstrated: Does NOT prove that all orographic physical processes or Scandes terrain effects are non-existent; proves specifically that this preregistered 2-feature representation fails to add incremental predictive value over frozen 37-feature Stage 8.1 control.
routes_with_qualified_provisional_closur.reopen_condition: Route closed under POLARIS governance guidelines; no further feature variations authorized.

routes_with_qualified_provisional_closur.tested: Real AROME-Arctic disagreement features (wind_disagreement_700, LWP_disagreement) from arome_arctic_347_origins_real_subset.csv
routes_with_qualified_provisional_closur.demonstrated: Real AROME disagreement features degraded held-out ODD performance (delta MAE = +0.2154 W/m², delta nMAE = +0.1671 pp, delta RMSE = +0.3811 W/m²)
routes_with_qualified_provisional_closur.not_demonstrated: Does NOT demonstrate that AROME data is unusable or unavailable; real data is 100% complete
routes_with_qualified_provisional_closur.reopen_condition: Only reopen if a materially different AROME physical representation is proposed and independently justified with verified causal real-data provenance

what_future_research_must_not_repeat.reason: Measured NWP model spin-up/drift rather than physical atmosphere; failed EVEN CV consistency gates.
Seasonal snow transition is 98.4% correlated with solar geometry (DOY, solar_elevation). Added zero skill.
Successfully incorporated into baseline (360° DEM horizon profile V_sky). Geometric shading is fully captured.
Publication latency (t_pub > t0) and SITES portal outages violated real-time causality.
Spatial cloud summaries added marginal skill (+0.19 W/m²) that failed EVEN gates due to NWP spatial displacement errors.
Pristine Arctic background AOD (<0.05) makes AOD immaterial (<1.2 W/m²); TCWV is redundant with MEPS humidity.
Ensemble spread failed EVEN CV gates; spread indicates model disagreement, not true target residual direction.
Real AROME revalidation (arome_arctic_347_origins_real_subset.csv, 100% coverage) degraded held-out ODD (delta MAE = +0.2154 W/m²).
Ray geometry failed EVEN CV gates (+0.03 W/m² degradation); MEPS 3D cloud placement errors compound along slant paths.
High-latitude view distortion (VZA 78.07°, >21km parallax, >14.5km pixel stretch); LEO polar pass latency (>1.5h) fails causality.
Failed EVEN CV robustness gates (G1, G2, G3 FAIL); local surface microclimate does not predict aloft cloud optical depth.
Faithful discrete layer-integrated N_layer + U_perp candidate degraded EVEN MAE (+0.2543 W/m2) and failed Gates G1-G4 (1/5 folds improving, worst fold = +0.7186 W/m2).
Geometrically constrained (V_terrain = 5.78%); realistic mean flux is immaterial (2.5-4.5 W/m²); input features redundant with Stage 7.5.
No continuous calibrated 2024 all-sky cam archive exists; SGO EMCCD turned off during daytime; LEO pass coverage <21% and non-causal.
All 5 domains proved immaterial (<1.8 W/m²), redundant with Stage 8.1, or causally unavailable.

next_research_boundary.rule: Future research must target genuinely independent physical information not represented by Stage 8.1 context, MEPS state/clouds, Stage 7.5 terrain, Stage 6.6 LWP/IWP, Stage 8.1 winds, CAMS AOD/TCWV, satellite motion, local surface state, orographic flow, terrain reflection, or fine atmospheric physics.
